body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
Running Wyrd for real needs its metadata database and coordination layer to stand up as an actual multi-node, disk-backed cluster. This provides the deployment recipe that brings that cluster up from scratch — not tied to any one orchestrator — so an operator can run the production tier.

**Scope:** the system's first heavy external **stateful** dependency, landed under ADR-0010's constraints. Topology is the single-zone **"Small multi-node Production"** profile (architecture §7.1): **TiKV (small) + its own PD cluster + a 3-node etcd ensemble for L5 Coordination + local-disk D servers — no L2/L3/TiDB**. The two coordinators are distinct and both required: PD ships with TiKV (regions + timestamp oracle); the **etcd ensemble** backs Wyrd's `Coordination` trait (discovery, leader election, fencing). TiKV/PD are stateful and disk-affine. Bring-up artifacts live in **`deploy/`, outside the Cargo workspace** — the structural guard against orchestrator coupling. Ship a **docker-compose** stack (TiKV + PD + the L5 etcd ensemble) for CI/eval; Helm chart/operator deferred. **"Kubernetes is available, never required," no code couples to orchestrator APIs, peers discovered through L5.**

**Definition of done**
- [ ] the single-zone "Small multi-node Production" stack stands up from `deploy/` (TiKV-small + PD cluster + 3-node etcd + local-disk D servers)
- [ ] peers discovered through Coordination (L5)
- [ ] **no crate imports a k8s/orchestrator API** (`deploy/` stays outside the workspace)
- [ ] docker-compose stack usable by CI/eval

**Needs:** M4.4 (and M4.1's throwaway TiKV evolves into this). **Refs:** proposal 0007 §"Deployment: TiKV/PD as a stateful…", §"Crate touch-points" (`deploy/`), §"Suggested PR sequence" (5); ADR-0010, ADR-0006. Branch `feat/m4.5-deploy-tikv-pd-etcd`, commit `feat(deploy): … (M4.5, #<issue>)`.

milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: M4.5 — production deployment: TiKV/PD + 3-node etcd as a stateful, disk-affine, orchestrator-agnostic tier (deploy/)
